meta.parties: Aitken Spence Amp Co v. Fernando

rules.statement: The costs of a successful appellant will be disallowed for discreditable and perverse conduct.
rules.supporting_quote: "Then there was a cross-appeal, and in my opinion that appeal should be dismissed without costs. The District Judge ought not to have entered up a decree after an appeal had been filed against his decision refusing to set aside the award, but should have waited until it had been finally decided whether the award was to stand or not. I should have wished to allow the appeal, but the words of section 692 of the Code are too clear to be disregarded, and provide that there is to be no appeal from such a decree as this. No doubt the parties are in some difficulty owing to entry of the decree, for the District Court has apparently no jurisdiction to set it aside when it has once been entered up. Possibly there may be some means, as by an application in revision, by which the matter may be set right."
